name: add
description: Stage selected file changes for the next commit.

name: am
description: Turn emailed patches into commits on your branch.

name: annotate
description: Inspect the commit responsible for each line, in an older output format.

name: apply
description: Apply a patch to files or the staging area without creating a commit.

name: archimport
description: Bring a GNU Arch project and its history into Git.

name: archive
description: Package a committed tree as a tar or zip archive.

name: backfill
description: Download missing historical blobs in a partial clone.

name: bisect
description: Find the commit that introduced a bug by testing progressively smaller ranges.
syntax:
git bisect start [--term-(bad|new)=<term-new> --term-(good|old)=<term-old>]
		   [--no-checkout] [--first-parent] [<bad> [<good>...]] [--] [<pathspec>...]
git bisect (bad|new|<term-new>) [<rev>]
git bisect (good|old|<term-old>) [<rev>...]
git bisect terms [--term-(good|old) | --term-(bad|new)]
git bisect skip [(<rev>|<range>)...]
git bisect next
git bisect reset [<commit>]
git bisect (visualize|view)
git bisect replay <logfile>
git bisect log
git bisect run <cmd> [<arg>...]
git bisect help

name: blame
description: Find who last changed each line and which commit contains that change.

name: branch
description: List, create, rename, or delete branch pointers.
syntax:
git branch [--color[=<when>] | --no-color] [--show-current]
	   [-v [--abbrev=<n> | --no-abbrev]]
	   [--column[=<options>] | --no-column] [--sort=<key>]
	   [--merged [<commit>]] [--no-merged [<commit>]]
	   [--contains [<commit>]] [--no-contains [<commit>]]
	   [--points-at <object>] [--format=<format>]
	   [(-r|--remotes) | (-a|--all)]
	   [--list] [<pattern>...]
git branch [--track[=(direct|inherit)] | --no-track] [-f]
	   [--recurse-submodules] <branch-name> [<start-point>]
git branch (--set-upstream-to=<upstream>|-u <upstream>) [<branch-name>]
git branch --unset-upstream [<branch-name>]
git branch (-m|-M) [<old-branch>] <new-branch>
git branch (-c|-C) [<old-branch>] <new-branch>
git branch (-d|-D) [-r] <branch-name>...
git branch --edit-description [<branch-name>]

name: bugreport
description: Collect environment information to help report a Git problem.

name: bundle
description: Transfer repository objects and references in a single portable file.
syntax:
git bundle create [-q | --quiet | --progress]
		    [--version=<version>] <file> <git-rev-list-args>
git bundle verify [-q | --quiet] <file>
git bundle list-heads <file> [<refname>...]
git bundle unbundle [--progress] <file> [<refname>...]

name: cat-file
description: Inspect an object’s type, size, or stored contents.
syntax:
git cat-file <type> <object>
git cat-file (-e | -p | -t | -s) <object>
git cat-file (--textconv | --filters)
	     [<rev>:<path|tree-ish> | --path=<path|tree-ish> <rev>]
git cat-file (--batch | --batch-check | --batch-command) [--batch-all-objects]
	     [--buffer] [--follow-symlinks] [--unordered]
	     [--textconv | --filters] [-Z]

name: check-attr
description: See which Git attributes apply to a path.

name: check-ignore
description: Find the ignore rule that excludes a file.

name: check-mailmap
description: Resolve contributor names and emails using mailmap rules.

name: check-ref-format
description: Check whether a proposed branch or reference name is valid.

name: checkout
description: Switch branches or restore files using Git’s older combined interface.
syntax:
git checkout [-q] [-f] [-m] [<branch>]
git checkout [-q] [-f] [-m] --detach [<branch>]
git checkout [-q] [-f] [-m] [--detach] <commit>
git checkout [-q] [-f] [-m] [[-b|-B|--orphan] <new-branch>] [<start-point>]
git checkout <tree-ish> [--] <pathspec>...
git checkout <tree-ish> --pathspec-from-file=<file> [--pathspec-file-nul]
git checkout [-f|--ours|--theirs|-m|--conflict=<style>] [--] <pathspec>...
git checkout [-f|--ours|--theirs|-m|--conflict=<style>] --pathspec-from-file=<file> [--pathspec-file-nul]
git checkout (-p|--patch) [<tree-ish>] [--] [<pathspec>...]

name: checkout-index
description: Copy staged file contents from the index into the working directory.

name: cherry
description: Identify commits whose patches are already present upstream.

name: cherry-pick
description: Apply selected existing commits onto your current branch.

name: citool
description: Open a graphical interface for staging and committing changes.

name: clean
description: Delete untracked files, with optional removal of ignored files.

name: clone
description: Create a local copy of a repository and its history.

name: column
description: Arrange text into columns for terminal output.

name: commit
description: Record staged changes as a new point in project history.

name: commit-graph
description: Write or verify an index that speeds up commit-history queries.
syntax:
git commit-graph verify [--object-dir <dir>] [--shallow] [--[no-]progress]
git commit-graph write [--object-dir <dir>] [--append]
			[--split[=<strategy>]] [--reachable | --stdin-packs | --stdin-commits]
			[--changed-paths] [--[no-]max-new-filters <n>] [--[no-]progress]
			<split-options>

name: commit-tree
description: Create a commit object directly from a tree and parent commits.

name: config
description: Read or change Git settings at local, global, or system scope.
syntax:
git config list [<file-option>] [<display-option>] [--includes]
git config get [<file-option>] [<display-option>] [--includes] [--all] [--regexp] [--value=<pattern>] [--fixed-value] [--default=<default>] [--url=<url>] <name>
git config set [<file-option>] [--type=<type>] [--all] [--value=<pattern>] [--fixed-value] <name> <value>
git config unset [<file-option>] [--all] [--value=<pattern>] [--fixed-value] <name>
git config rename-section [<file-option>] <old-name> <new-name>
git config remove-section [<file-option>] <name>
git config edit [<file-option>]
git config [<file-option>] --get-colorbool <name> [<stdout-is-tty>]

name: count-objects
description: Measure loose objects and packed storage in a repository.

name: credential
description: Pass authentication requests to configured credential helpers.

name: credential-cache
description: Keep credentials temporarily in memory through a helper process.

name: credential-store
description: Save credentials to an unencrypted file for later authentication.

name: cvsexportcommit
description: Send the changes from one Git commit to a CVS checkout.

name: cvsimport
description: Convert CVS history into a Git repository.

name: cvsserver
description: Expose a Git repository through a CVS-compatible server.
syntax:
SSH:

export CVS_SERVER="git cvsserver"
cvs -d :ext:user@server/path/repo.git co <HEAD_name>

pserver (/etc/inetd.conf):

cvspserver stream tcp nowait nobody /usr/bin/git-cvsserver git-cvsserver pserver

Usage:

git-cvsserver [<options>] [pserver|server] [<directory> ...]

name: daemon
description: Serve repositories over the native Git protocol.

name: describe
description: Give a commit a readable name based on nearby tags.
syntax:
git describe [--all] [--tags] [--contains] [--abbrev=<n>] [<commit-ish>...]
git describe [--all] [--tags] [--contains] [--abbrev=<n>] --dirty[=<mark>]
git describe <blob>

name: diagnose
description: Create a diagnostic archive for investigating repository problems.

name: diff
description: Compare changes between files, the index, commits, or branches.
syntax:
git diff [<options>] [<commit>] [--] [<path>...]
git diff [<options>] --cached [--merge-base] [<commit>] [--] [<path>...]
git diff [<options>] [--merge-base] <commit> [<commit>...] <commit> [--] [<path>...]
git diff [<options>] <commit>...<commit> [--] [<path>...]
git diff [<options>] <blob> <blob>
git diff [<options>] --no-index [--] <path> <path> [<pathspec>...]

name: diff-files
description: Compare working files against their staged versions.

name: diff-index
description: Compare a tree with the index or working directory.

name: diff-pairs
description: Compare object pairs supplied through standard input.

name: diff-tree
description: Compare the contents of two tree objects.

name: difftool
description: Open a configured external tool to compare changes visually.

name: fast-export
description: Write repository history in a stream suitable for transfer or conversion.

name: fast-import
description: Build repository objects from a structured import stream.

name: fetch
description: Download remote objects and update remote-tracking references.
syntax:
git fetch [<options>] [<repository> [<refspec>...]]
git fetch [<options>] <group>
git fetch --multiple [<options>] [(<repository>|<group>)...]
git fetch --all [<options>]

name: fetch-pack
description: Retrieve objects from another repository using the low-level transfer protocol.

name: filter-branch
description: Rewrite a range of commits using filters; prefer modern migration tools for large rewrites.

name: fmt-merge-msg
description: Prepare a merge message from a list of incoming branch tips.

name: for-each-ref
description: List references using a customizable output format.

name: for-each-repo
description: Run a Git command across repositories listed in configuration.

name: format-patch
description: Export commits as patches suitable for email review.

name: fsck
description: Check the integrity and connectivity of stored Git objects.

name: gc
description: Run repository cleanup and storage optimization.

name: get-tar-commit-id
description: Read the embedded commit identifier from a Git-generated tar archive.

name: grep
description: Search tracked content or committed trees for a pattern.

name: gui
description: Open Git’s optional graphical staging and repository interface.

name: hash-object
description: Calculate an object identifier and optionally store the object.

name: help
description: Open documentation for a command or Git topic.
syntax:
git help [-a|--all] [--[no-]verbose] [--[no-]external-commands] [--[no-]aliases]
git help [[-i|--info] [-m|--man] [-w|--web]] [<command>|<doc>]
git help [-g|--guides]
git help [-c|--config]
git help [--user-interfaces]
git help [--developer-interfaces]

name: history
description: Experimentally reword or split commits while rewriting their descendants.
syntax:
git history reword <commit> [--dry-run] [--update-refs=(branches|head)]
git history split <commit> [--dry-run] [--update-refs=(branches|head)] [--] [<pathspec>...]

name: hook
description: Run a configured repository hook explicitly.
syntax:
git hook run [--allow-unknown-hook-name] [--ignore-missing] [--to-stdin=<path>] <hook-name> [-- <hook-args>]
git hook list [--allow-unknown-hook-name] [-z] [--show-scope] <hook-name>

name: http-backend
description: Provide Git repository access through an HTTP server’s CGI interface.

name: http-fetch
description: Retrieve objects over HTTP using a low-level helper.

name: http-push
description: Send objects to a WebDAV-enabled HTTP remote.

name: imap-send
description: Upload prepared patch emails to an IMAP mailbox.

name: index-pack
description: Build an index for a packfile and verify its objects.

name: init
description: Start a repository in a new or existing directory.

name: instaweb
description: Launch a temporary web interface for browsing a local repository.

name: interpret-trailers
description: Read or update structured fields at the end of commit messages.

name: last-modified
description: Find the most recent commit affecting each requested path.

name: log
description: Browse commit history with filters and formatting options.

name: ls-files
description: List paths known to the index and inspect their tracking state.

name: ls-remote
description: List branches and tags advertised by a remote repository.

name: ls-tree
description: List the files and directories recorded in a tree object.

name: mailinfo
description: Extract a commit message and patch from an email.

name: mailsplit
description: Split a mailbox into individual message files.

name: maintenance
description: Schedule or run tasks that keep repository storage efficient.
syntax:
git maintenance run [<options>]
git maintenance start [--scheduler=<scheduler>]
git maintenance (stop|register|unregister) [<options>]
git maintenance is-needed [<options>]

name: merge
description: Integrate another branch’s history into the current branch.

name: merge-base
description: Find shared ancestors used to compare or merge commits.
syntax:
git merge-base [-a | --all] <commit> <commit>...
git merge-base [-a | --all] --octopus <commit>...
git merge-base --is-ancestor <commit> <commit>
git merge-base --independent <commit>...
git merge-base --fork-point <ref> [<commit>]

name: merge-file
description: Perform a three-way merge of individual files.

name: merge-index
description: Run a merge helper for unmerged index entries.

name: merge-one-file
description: Use Git’s basic single-file merge helper.

name: merge-tree
description: Compute a merge result without switching the working tree.

name: mergetool
description: Resolve merge conflicts using an external editor or visual tool.

name: mktag
description: Validate and store an annotated tag object from input.

name: mktree
description: Create a tree object from a formatted list of entries.

name: multi-pack-index
description: Manage an index spanning multiple object packfiles.
syntax:
git multi-pack-index [<options>] write [--preferred-pack=<pack>]
		         [--[no-]bitmap] [--[no-]incremental] [--[no-]stdin-packs]
		         [--refs-snapshot=<path>]
git multi-pack-index [<options>] compact [--[no-]incremental]
		         [--[no-]bitmap] <from> <to>
git multi-pack-index [<options>] verify
git multi-pack-index [<options>] expire
git multi-pack-index [<options>] repack [--batch-size=<size>]

name: mv
description: Move or rename tracked paths and stage the change.

name: name-rev
description: Express commits in terms of reachable reference names.

name: notes
description: Attach supplementary text to objects without editing their commits.
syntax:
git notes [list [<object>]]
git notes add [-f] [--allow-empty] [--[no-]separator | --separator=<paragraph-break>] [--[no-]stripspace] [-F <file> | -m <msg> | (-c | -C) <object>] [-e] [<object>]
git notes copy [-f] ( --stdin | <from-object> [<to-object>] )
git notes append [--allow-empty] [--[no-]separator | --separator=<paragraph-break>] [--[no-]stripspace] [-F <file> | -m <msg> | (-c | -C) <object>] [-e] [<object>]
git notes edit [--allow-empty] [<object>] [--[no-]stripspace]
git notes show [<object>]
git notes merge [-v | -q] [-s <strategy> ] <notes-ref>
git notes merge --commit [-v | -q]
git notes merge --abort [-v | -q]
git notes remove [--ignore-missing] [--stdin] [<object>...]
git notes prune [-n] [-v]
git notes get-ref

name: p4
description: Exchange changes between Git and a Perforce depot.
syntax:
git p4 clone [<sync-options>] [<clone-options>] <p4-depot-path>...
git p4 sync [<sync-options>] [<p4-depot-path>...]
git p4 rebase
git p4 submit [<submit-options>] [<master-branch-name>]

name: pack-objects
description: Compress objects into packfiles for storage or transfer.

name: pack-redundant
description: Identify packfiles whose objects are already stored elsewhere.

name: pack-refs
description: Consolidate references into compact storage.

name: patch-id
description: Calculate a patch fingerprint for comparing equivalent changes.

name: prune
description: Remove unreachable loose objects from repository storage.

name: prune-packed
description: Remove loose copies of objects already present in packs.

name: pull
description: Fetch remote changes and integrate them into the current branch.

name: push
description: Publish local references and objects to a remote repository.

name: quiltimport
description: Import a quilt patch series as Git commits.

name: range-diff
description: Compare two versions of a commit series during review.

name: read-tree
description: Load tree contents into the index, optionally updating working files.

name: rebase
description: Replay commits on another base or edit local commit history.
syntax:
git rebase [-i | --interactive] [<options>] [--exec <cmd>]
	[--onto <newbase> | --keep-base] [<upstream> [<branch>]]
git rebase [-i | --interactive] [<options>] [--exec <cmd>] [--onto <newbase>]
	--root [<branch>]
git rebase (--continue|--skip|--abort|--quit|--edit-todo|--show-current-patch)

name: receive-pack
description: Accept a push on the receiving side of a Git connection.

name: reflog
description: Inspect or manage the local record of reference movements.
syntax:
git reflog [show] [<log-options>] [<ref>]
git reflog list
git reflog exists <ref>
git reflog write <ref> <old-oid> <new-oid> <message>
git reflog delete [--rewrite] [--updateref]
	[--dry-run | -n] [--verbose] <ref>@{<specifier>}...
git reflog drop [--all [--single-worktree] | <refs>...]
git reflog expire [--expire=<time>] [--expire-unreachable=<time>]
	[--rewrite] [--updateref] [--stale-fix]
	[--dry-run | -n] [--verbose] [--all [--single-worktree] | <refs>...]

name: refs
description: Inspect, verify, or migrate reference storage.
syntax:
git refs migrate --ref-format=<format> [--no-reflog] [--dry-run]
git refs verify [--strict] [--verbose]
git refs list [--count=<count>] [--shell|--perl|--python|--tcl]
		   [(--sort=<key>)...] [--format=<format>]
		   [--include-root-refs] [--points-at=<object>]
		   [--merged[=<object>]] [--no-merged[=<object>]]
		   [--contains[=<object>]] [--no-contains[=<object>]]
		   [(--exclude=<pattern>)...] [--start-after=<marker>]
		   [ --stdin | (<pattern>...)]
git refs exists <ref>
git refs optimize [--all] [--no-prune] [--auto] [--include <pattern>] [--exclude <pattern>]

name: remote
description: Manage remote repository addresses and tracking configuration.
syntax:
git remote [-v | --verbose]
git remote add [-t <branch>] [-m <master>] [-f] [--[no-]tags] [--mirror=(fetch|push)] <name> <URL>
git remote rename [--[no-]progress] <old> <new>
git remote remove <name>
git remote set-head <name> (-a | --auto | -d | --delete | <branch>)
git remote set-branches [--add] <name> <branch>...
git remote get-url [--push] [--all] <name>
git remote set-url [--push] <name> <newurl> [<oldurl>]
git remote set-url --add [--push] <name> <newurl>
git remote set-url --delete [--push] <name> <URL>
git remote [-v | --verbose] show [-n] <name>...
git remote prune [-n | --dry-run] <name>...
git remote [-v | --verbose] update [-p | --prune] [(<group> | <remote>)...]

name: repack
description: Reorganize stored objects into packfiles.

name: replace
description: Configure substitute objects for history inspection.
syntax:
git replace [-f] <object> <replacement>
git replace [-f] --edit <object>
git replace [-f] --graft <commit> [<parent>...]
git replace [-f] --convert-graft-file
git replace -d <object>...
git replace [--format=<format>] [-l [<pattern>]]

name: replay
description: Replay commits without requiring a working tree; this interface is experimental.

name: repo
description: Inspect or manage repositories known to Git.
syntax:
git repo info [--format=(lines|nul) | -z] [--all | <key>...]
git repo info --keys [--format=(lines|nul) | -z]
git repo structure [--format=(table|lines|nul) | -z]

name: request-pull
description: Prepare a summary asking someone to pull a published branch.

name: rerere
description: Record conflict resolutions and reuse them when the same conflict returns.
syntax: git rerere [clear | forget <pathspec>... | diff | status | remaining | gc]

name: reset
description: Move a branch pointer or reset staged files; some modes discard local changes.
syntax:
git reset [--soft | --mixed [-N] | --hard | --merge | --keep] [-q] [<commit>]
git reset [-q] [<tree-ish>] [--] <pathspec>...
git reset [-q] [--pathspec-from-file=<file> [--pathspec-file-nul]] [<tree-ish>]
git reset (--patch | -p) [<tree-ish>] [--] [<pathspec>...]

name: restore
description: Restore working files or unstage changes from a chosen source.
syntax:
git restore [<options>] [--source=<tree>] [--staged] [--worktree] [--] <pathspec>...
git restore [<options>] [--source=<tree>] [--staged] [--worktree] --pathspec-from-file=<file> [--pathspec-file-nul]
git restore (-p|--patch) [<options>] [--source=<tree>] [--staged] [--worktree] [--] [<pathspec>...]

name: rev-list
description: Enumerate commits or objects reachable under specified history constraints.

name: rev-parse
description: Resolve revisions and query repository paths or parsing rules.

name: revert
description: Create new commits that reverse earlier changes while retaining shared history.

name: rm
description: Remove tracked files and stage their deletion.

name: send-email
description: Send a patch series to reviewers by email.
syntax:
git send-email [<options>] (<file>|<directory>)...
git send-email [<options>] <format-patch-options>
git send-email --dump-aliases
git send-email --translate-aliases

name: send-pack
description: Send objects and reference updates using the low-level push protocol.

name: sh-i18n
description: Provide translation helpers for Git shell scripts.

name: sh-setup
description: Provide common initialization helpers for Git shell scripts.

name: shell
description: Restrict an SSH account to permitted Git server operations.

name: shortlog
description: Summarize commits grouped by author or another field.
syntax:
git shortlog [<options>] [<revision-range>] [[--] <path>...]
git log --pretty=short | git shortlog [<options>]

name: show
description: Display a commit, tag, tree, or file object.

name: show-branch
description: Compare the ancestry and tips of multiple branches.

name: show-index
description: Inspect entries inside a pack index.

name: show-ref
description: List reference names and the object identifiers they point to.
syntax:
git show-ref [--head] [-d | --dereference]
	     [-s | --hash[=<n>]] [--abbrev[=<n>]] [--branches] [--tags]
	     [--] [<pattern>...]
git show-ref --verify [-q | --quiet] [-d | --dereference]
	     [-s | --hash[=<n>]] [--abbrev[=<n>]]
	     [--] [<ref>...]
git show-ref --exclude-existing[=<pattern>]
git show-ref --exists <ref>

name: sparse-checkout
description: Limit which tracked paths appear in your working directory.
syntax: git sparse-checkout (init | list | set | add | reapply | disable | check-rules | clean) [<options>]

name: stage
description: Stage file changes; an alternative spelling of git add.

name: stash
description: Save unfinished work temporarily and restore it later.
syntax:
git stash list [<log-options>]
git stash show [-u | --include-untracked | --only-untracked] [<diff-options>] [<stash>]
git stash drop [-q | --quiet] [<stash>]
git stash pop [--index] [-q | --quiet] [<stash>]
git stash apply [--index] [-q | --quiet] [<stash>]
git stash branch <branchname> [<stash>]
git stash [push] [-p | --patch] [-S | --staged] [-k | --[no-]keep-index] [-q | --quiet]
	     [-u | --include-untracked] [-a | --all] [(-m | --message) <message>]
	     [--pathspec-from-file=<file> [--pathspec-file-nul]]
	     [--] [<pathspec>...]
git stash save [-p | --patch] [-S | --staged] [-k | --[no-]keep-index] [-q | --quiet]
           [-u | --include-untracked] [-a | --all] [<message>]
git stash clear
git stash create [<message>]
git stash store [(-m | --message) <message>] [-q | --quiet] <commit>
git stash export (--print | --to-ref <ref>) [<stash>...]
git stash import <commit>

name: status
description: Inspect staged, modified, and untracked files and the current branch.

name: stripspace
description: Normalize whitespace and optionally handle comment lines in text.

name: submodule
description: Manage external repositories recorded inside a parent repository.
syntax:
git submodule [--quiet] [--cached]
git submodule [--quiet] add [<options>] [--] <repository> [<path>]
git submodule [--quiet] status [--cached] [--recursive] [--] [<path>...]
git submodule [--quiet] init [--] [<path>...]
git submodule [--quiet] deinit [-f|--force] (--all|[--] <path>...)
git submodule [--quiet] update [<options>] [--] [<path>...]
git submodule [--quiet] set-branch [<options>] [--] <path>
git submodule [--quiet] set-url [--] <path> <newurl>
git submodule [--quiet] summary [<options>] [--] [<path>...]
git submodule [--quiet] foreach [--recursive] <command>
git submodule [--quiet] sync [--recursive] [--] [<path>...]
git submodule [--quiet] absorbgitdirs [--] [<path>...]

name: svn
description: Exchange commits between Git and a Subversion repository.

name: switch
description: Change branches or create and switch to a new branch.
syntax:
git switch [<options>] [--no-guess] <branch>
git switch [<options>] --detach [<start-point>]
git switch [<options>] (-c|-C) <new-branch> [<start-point>]
git switch [<options>] --orphan <new-branch>

name: symbolic-ref
description: Inspect or update references that point to other references.
syntax:
git symbolic-ref [-m <reason>] <name> <ref>
git symbolic-ref [-q] [--short] [--no-recurse] <name>
git symbolic-ref --delete [-q] <name>

name: tag
description: Create, inspect, verify, or delete tags marking points in history.
syntax:
git tag [-a | -s | -u <key-id>] [-f] [-m <msg> | -F <file>] [-e]
	[(--trailer <token>[(=|:)<value>])...]
	<tagname> [<commit> | <object>]
git tag -d <tagname>...
git tag [-n[<num>]] -l [--contains <commit>] [--no-contains <commit>]
	[--points-at <object>] [--column[=<options>] | --no-column]
	[--create-reflog] [--sort=<key>] [--format=<format>]
	[--merged <commit>] [--no-merged <commit>] [<pattern>...]
git tag -v [--format=<format>] <tagname>...

name: unpack-file
description: Write a blob object to a temporary file.

name: unpack-objects
description: Extract objects from a pack stream into repository storage.

name: update-index
description: Modify index entries directly for advanced staging workflows.

name: update-ref
description: Create, change, or delete references with optional transaction checks.
syntax:
git update-ref [-m <reason>] [--no-deref] -d <ref> [<old-oid>]
git update-ref [-m <reason>] [--no-deref] [--create-reflog] <ref> <new-oid> [<old-oid>]
git update-ref [-m <reason>] [--no-deref] --stdin [-z] [--batch-updates]

name: update-server-info
description: Refresh auxiliary files used by simple remote transports.

name: upload-archive
description: Serve an archive request from a remote client.

name: upload-pack
description: Prepare objects for clients fetching from a repository.

name: var
description: Print Git’s resolved values for supported environment-related variables.

name: verify-commit
description: Validate cryptographic signatures attached to commits.

name: verify-pack
description: Check a packfile and inspect its indexed objects.

name: verify-tag
description: Validate cryptographic signatures attached to tags.

name: version
description: Print the installed Git version and optional build details.

name: whatchanged
description: Inspect history using an older command; use git log for new workflows.

name: worktree
description: Manage separate working directories attached to one repository.
syntax:
git worktree add [-f] [--detach] [--checkout] [--lock [--reason <string>]]
		 [--orphan] [(-b | -B) <new-branch>] <path> [<commit-ish>]
git worktree list [-v | --porcelain [-z]]
git worktree lock [--reason <string>] <worktree>
git worktree move <worktree> <new-path>
git worktree prune [-n] [-v] [--expire <expire>]
git worktree remove [-f] <worktree>
git worktree repair [<path>...]
git worktree unlock <worktree>

name: write-tree
description: Store the current index as a tree object.
